notes: The author self-declares a Fortnite-style Battle Royale, so Shooter leads, but the answers scope this first version to the lobby alone and forbid building a match map - so none of Shooter's presets apply, since all nine are match layouts, and the Battle Royale preset's shrinking boundary and scattered loot would build the thing they excluded. What is actually being built is a small stylised waiting space for up to ten players, so I took Entertainment as the second genre and its Hub preset, swapping hub-portals for space-bounded and dropping teleporter-link: there is no separate match zone to portal into yet, so the P4 those two carry is unjustified and this routes P0. I also rejected space-staged for the same reason - its whole point is isolating a match area from the lobby, and only the lobby exists. Added spawn-first-reveal because a stylised lobby is judged entirely on the shot players land in, while the R15 warning pop-up, the validation button and the Classique/Rendu epure toggle are UI and lighting states over one set of geometry rather than layout, so nothing in the build expresses them, the toggle does not make this two maps, and the stated ten-player capacity is simply the lobby's sizing.
